claims.text: Warfarin dose was changed to 4 mg each evening.

citations.quote: Warfarin dose changed to 4 mg each evening.

open_questions: When was warfarin first started, and what was its initial dose and indication?
What were the recent INR values and dose adjustments before this change to 4 mg?
Was there any bleeding or adverse event associated with the raised INR?
What other medications could interact with warfarin or affect INR?
Are there earlier records of over-anticoagulation or prior INR monitoring plans?
When is the next INR check scheduled after this dose change?
Which allergies or reactions are recorded for this patient?
Which follow-ups, referrals or tests are planned or outstanding?

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: INR of 3.4 alongside a warfarin dose change; no bleeding assessment or follow-up INR is documented.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Clinician to review INR and confirm timing of follow-up INR test.

check_points.text: Confirm an INR has been checked within one week of the warfarin dose change to 4 mg each evening.

reference.quote: Check the INR within one week of any warfarin dose change.
